originality.rationale: Full-text comparison reveals that Chrisnata et al. (2021/2023) state precisely the proved generating function as Conjecture 1, after only a lower bound and finite coefficient checks. This proof establishes the missing exact collision involution and all-length count. Neither the foundational 2013 infinite-word paper nor the 2020 finite-word 2-binomial and general-growth treatment states this weight-three 3-deck enumeration. Actual semantically targeted published-finding-index and literature searches did not uncover a stronger covering theorem; priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
residual_risks: Search does not prove priority: an unindexed or unpublished independent proof of Conjecture 1 could exist.
The 2026 hyperplane-arrangement paper was only inspected via its abstract; its stated binary 2-binomial subject does not imply this exact 3-binomial theorem.
The invariant is a narrowly fixed-weight three-deck problem, not the unrestricted reconstruction count.
